notes: One cost unit for the whole console, and three quiet fixes behind it. Model and token costs now follow the currency selected in Settings and carry its ISO code; when a price or a rate is missing the amount reads unknown instead of zero, while guardrail budgets and venue limits stay explicitly in USD. Behind that, four defects are gone: the automatic rate cache no longer serves one currency's number under another currency's label, a cached usage aggregate no longer keeps a stale unit, a missing price no longer becomes a false zero, and an unknown budget no longer draws a zero-valued arc. The speech path on our side no longer borrows the chat endpoint or its key, refuses overlapping requests, cools down after an upstream error and never relays an upstream error body; browser notices now use on-device voices only, and the console smoke suite calls real speech synthesis only when it is explicitly asked to. The clone ledger now enforces its daily row cap across processes, the console shows per-slot cooldown observations from its own process, and the stream view renders read-only fleet cards that keep approval records and finished runs apart instead of guessing a link between them. A first stage of memory suppression ships without any user-facing control: a per-profile ledger of opaque source ids filters admission, the read paths and restores, and travels with a backup so a restore cannot silently un-forget a source; nothing is ever deleted, and the original transcript, published history and earlier backups stay untouched. Two gate defects are fixed as well: the smoke suite could leave the console paused after an interrupted run and refuse every later turn, and the product site carried a stale module count next to its badge. No new credential, no new outbound path, no change to any shared gateway.
